title: Decent Screenshot
description: View and manage your Minecraft screenshots inside the game with a clean, fully-integrated UI.
body:
# DecentScreenshot

View and manage your Minecraft screenshots inside the game with a clean, fully-integrated UI.

---

## Features
- **In-Game Gallery**: View your screenshots in a scrollable, responsive grid.
- **Fullscreen Viewer**: Click to view screenshots in full detail.
- **Cycle Navigation**: Cycle through screenshots using on-screen buttons or arrow keys.
- **Organize & Manage**: Rename or delete screenshots directly inside the game.
- **Quick Access**: Button to open the local screenshots directory in your file explorer.

---

## Usage & Controls
- **F10** (configurable): Open the gallery screen.
- **Left / Right Arrow**: Navigate to the previous/next screenshot in the viewer.
- **ESC**: Back out of the viewer or close the gallery.

---

## Technical Details & Support
- **Environment**: Client-side only. Installing on a server does nothing.
- **Requirements**: Fabric Loader & Fabric API.
- **Version Compatibility**: Targets Minecraft versions using Java 25.

---

## Open Source
This mod is open-source and released under the CC0 license.
- Source Code: [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/bloodredx/decentscreenshot)
